declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_kh <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_kh like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_kh) + '%''' if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from d48 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'id not in (select id from ctct20 where loai_tt = 1 and id in (select id from ctchi20) group by ma_kh, ma_nt, id) and ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id', 'b.ma_unit', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date, @DetailTable varchar(32), @MasterTable varchar(32), @key nvarchar(4000) = '', @s NVARCHAR(4000) set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 0 then 5 when 5 then 0 else 5 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 0 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 0 then getdate() else null end
update m48 set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d48 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
SELECT @key = @key + CAST(CAST(id AS DECIMAL(30, 0)) AS NVARCHAR(30)) + ',' FROM @tblKeys;
SET @key = LEFT(@key, LEN(@key) - 1);
exec dbo.insertCTCHI20 'm48', 'd48', @key, @deststatus
exec dbo.st_TongHopQuy
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case when @xstatus = 0 then 9 else 5 end
update m48 set status = @deststatus, ly_do_huy = @ly_do_huy where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d48 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
